notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures that have menace and that do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare at least five creatures with menace as attackers. J. Jonah Jameson's second ability triggers for each creature, creating that many Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase, and activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
